open_points.subject: PortRef capture input contract
open_points.text: The functions capability keeps the broad PortRef input contract.
open_points.question: Which module owns the PortRef union and the definitions and tags of StoredValuesRef, SpooledFilesRef and FileFactsRef that `runs` constructs and `functions` discriminates?
options: Each producing module owns its own reference variant

open_points.subject: Capture file-reference classification
open_points.text: `runs` passes to `functions.add_captured_trial_case` the executed implementation and the inputs of the record it captures, spooled files as their SpooledFiles, with the contract version the caller named; `functions` ... checks the complete input tuple and refuses any FileFactsRef, even an empty one
open_points.question: Which module decides whether each file input from a NodeExecution becomes a SpooledFilesRef or remains a FileFactsRef, and how is an empty `many` file reference classified when it contains no SpooledFile by which to distinguish the variants?
options: `runs` classifies and constructs every reference before calling `functions`
`functions` classifies references from the NodeExecution facts
The stored NodeExecution reference already preserves the variant
open_points.default_guess: The stored NodeExecution reference preserves the variant, and `runs` passes it unchanged.
